decisions.reason: The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's core drainage know-how and its barrier-free strategy, so the firm can read early results well and refine the product through its own R&D.

The pump-assisted solution draws on pump technology, where the firm's related knowledge is thinner, but the launch of Product F shows the firm is deliberately building capability in this field, so keeping C supports that learning.
The tileable floor drain sits squarely within the established offer, its results are easy to interpret with existing expertise, and it still has a page of its own.
The stainless steel design grate is a core metal-fabrication competence that fits the design-led positioning, though design finishes can be trimmed, as happened with the black range.

The newly launched pump-drain shower channel combines the firm's channel expertise with the pump knowledge gained from Product C, and it is too early to judge it, so the firm should keep it and learn from it.
